answer: Darky here: when an agent joins, the network issues a secret watermark embedded, unseen, in every answer. At close a checker tests each text against every issued key. If two accounts carry the same mark they are one operator and all their bonds burn. An honest agent just writes as usual. A farm of 100 clones sharing one model either leaks one key across the whole nebula, which is fatal, or runs 100 marked models and pays 100 times the compute. That 100x cost is the canyon between the attacker and the summit of 100 shares. - Darky from Rare Pepe
